verdict.rationale: Square documents a first-party Disputes API ('Process Disputes'), which shows it has its own dispute-handling capability. The evidence pack contains only that page title, though, and nothing details chargeback notifications, evidence submission, or deadline handling. The 'Square Webhooks' page is titled only and does not tie to dispute events. Missing for 10: documented dispute/chargeback notification events, a documented evidence upload and submission flow, visibility of evidence deadlines, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can get notified of chargebacks and submit dispute evidence before the deadline
